client_brief:
A restrained healthcare image set with a reliable clinical-lead cutout

Palewell needs photography that feels credible together, even though most of the set will be licensed and only one frame is owned. Please prioritise compatible camera scale, neutral balance and depth over a collection of individually attractive stock photographs.

The clinical lead will appear on a deep-colour header. Hair and shoulder edges need to be checked there, at the real placement size.

Commissioned outputs:

The licensed frames plus the one owned frame brought to a single house neutral: one white point, one black point, one warmth and one depth of field character, so that laid side by side the way a site lays them they read as one world rather than as six purchases. Delivered at camera-scale with a per-frame parameter log naming what was applied and why that frame differed from its neighbours. Nothing generative tech, nothing enlarged.

The clinical lead isolated from the corridor as a genuinely transparent asset with real edge quality along the shoulder and the hairline, plus a plate of her composited onto the brand's deep ground, both judged at the size the header actually reproduces rather than at preview scale. This is one cutout with one edge logic in two carriers, not one picture at two sizes.

The commission is budgeted at $1,800-$4,500 fixed. We have allowed 2 to 4 weeks, including one direction checkpoint and two consolidated revision rounds. New deliverable classes, new source creation, extra records, and client copy changes after approval are quoted separately.

The supplied starting material is palewell_shortlist_grabs/ (11 screenshots the founders saved); palewell_lead_frame.jpg (4480 x 6720, the one photograph they own); palewell_site_grabs/ (5 PNGs); palewell_employer_onepager.pdf; palewell_brand_notes.md; palewell_copy.txt.

Also in the archive, for background only: palewell_employers.csv (14 rows). These do not add deliverables to this commission.

This is photographic production, with no generative imagery and no enlargement beyond the source. Keep the transparent portrait and the prepared header plate distinct so the site team knows which file belongs where.

Handover: a delivery manifest, the editable sources specified above, final exports, a short production and exceptions note and Stock license and asset IDs. Include an inventory showing how every supplied file was used or why it was set aside. Keep factual content tied to the approved inputs. Any missing coverage, substituted asset, reconciliation or quality compromise must be declared; a weak source is not permission to invent or silently replace it.

source_provenance.original_anchor: The ledger row for this slot carries no quoted post, so the anchor is stated plainly rather than invented. This is the standing shape of the 'we have no shoot, buy us imagery we can stand behind' brief that runs continuously on Upwork and Freelancer.com for early stage health and benefits platforms: the posted ask is licensed hero photography, one consistent look across a set rather than six good pictures, a clean subject cutout for a header lockup, platform sized ad variants, and the licensing paperwork named as a deliverable because the buyer sits in a compliance sensitive category. The ledger's own one line ask is carried into the brief's spine verbatim in substance: license a few genuinely on brand care and clinician frames, grade them to a calm clinical look, isolate the lead subject cleanly for the hero lockup, and hand over the heroes at web and ad sizes. Its collateral set names a wide website hero, a subject isolated hero cutout as a transparent PNG, 1:1 / 4:5 / 16:9 ad heroes, a licensed shortlist or mood board, and a source and licensing manifest with generative tech excluded. The verdict is REBUILD, and the reason is that the concept as written sits almost entirely on one surface (imaging, with Stock as a front end): license, grade, cut out, resize. CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10) changes what the honest fuller commission is, because HTML authoring now yields a native editable Express document carrying several canvas sizes at once, and a client supplied press PDF can be reverse engineered into a live merge template. The employer channel named in the ledger's own price and demographics line ('plus employer plans', buyers who are 'benefits leads') is where the fuller job actually lives: fourteen partner employers each need the same leave behind with their own name, plan tier and contact on it, one page each, which is a genuine record per page run rather than a design exercise.

price_band_and_audience: Subscription digital health at fifteen to forty dollars a month, plus employer plans sold to benefits leads; members are thirty to fifty five, the decision maker is often a benefits or HR lead reading for risk. The band is load-bearing. At this price the work has to read calm, credible and human: real rooms, ordinary daylight, restrained type, generous air, faces that are present rather than beaming. Push it up into a two hundred dollar concierge medicine look (near black grounds, sparse editorial styling, cosmetic gloss) and a benefits lead reads it as a perk their staff cannot use. Push it down into a high saturation, benefit stacked, promotional treatment and it reads as a supplement funnel, which in a health category actively destroys the trust the purchase requires. There is a third wrong answer specific to this vertical: a cold, sterile, blue clinical look that photographs well and feels like a hospital, which fails because the product is something people use at home. An agent that ships any of the three has misread the commission even if every technical gate passes. A real posted job of this shape runs 1,400 to 3,200 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.tagline: Care that meets you at home
brand_identity.sector: Direct to consumer digital health platform with a growing employer benefits channel, sold to members and to the benefits leads who choose on their behalf
brand_identity.founded_place_size: Founded 2019 in Portland, Oregon; an eleven person team, clinician led, still owner run
brand_identity.about: Palewell is a subscription digital health platform for people managing ordinary, everyday conditions from home. Members pay a modest monthly fee for clinician backed guidance, and about half our growth now comes through employer benefits teams who offer us to their staff. We exist so that steady, unglamorous care feels reachable rather than clinical.
brand_identity.audience: Members aged thirty to fifty five who want reassurance without a hospital, plus benefits and HR leads who evaluate us for risk and coverage before putting us in front of their people
brand_identity.price_positioning: Fifteen to forty dollars a month, plus employer plans. Mid market and accessible: above a free wellness app, well below concierge medicine. The read must never feel like a two hundred dollar boutique practice or a supplement funnel.
brand_identity.typography: A humanist serif for headlines that reads as considered and trustworthy, paired with a clean humanist sans for body and interface. Generous air, restrained scale, nothing shouting. The type should feel like a careful letter, not a brochure.
brand_identity.voice: Plain, warm and unhurried; we speak to a person, not a patient. We avoid hype, superlatives and clinical jargon. Example line the brand would write: "Manage the everyday stuff with someone in your corner, from home."
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: There is no formal brand book. What exists is an internal notes file describing the palette in words (a deep slate, a warm chalk, a single muted signal colour), the tone of voice, and what the founders mean by calm. We have never run a photo shoot: every image on the current site came free with the template, and we own exactly one photograph outright, of our clinical lead, cleared for use.
brand_identity.values: Credibility and warmth held together: real people in real rooms, honest about what we are, calm enough that a benefits lead trusts us with their staff.

assets_supplied.name: palewell_shortlist_grabs/ (11 screenshots the founders saved)
assets_supplied.kind: Screenshots of stock search results the founders liked, each showing a thumbnail, the contributor line and the frame's title.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The kinds of pictures we mean. We did not license any of them, we just saved what we liked."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Every one of these is a small content delivery thumbnail, which is a proxy that flattens colour: the true colour of a licensed frame only exists after the full resolution download, and several of these read neutral in the grab while carrying a strong practical light cast at full size. Two of the saved frames are also generative tech results, which the grab does not show and which the client has said they will not ship.

assets_supplied.name: palewell_lead_frame.jpg (4480 x 6720, the one photograph they own)
assets_supplied.kind: A single frame of their clinical lead taken by a conference photographer, standing in a corridor at a benefits fair, pale scrub top over a pale painted wall.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The only picture we own outright. She is our clinical lead and she has cleared us to use it."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Her scrub top and the corridor wall sit at almost the same luminance across her right shoulder and upper arm, so the one call knockout returns a cutout that is clean, complete and convincing against white or against a transparency preview while having quietly bitten into the shoulder line. The bite only becomes visible when the cutout is placed on the brand's deep ground at the size the header actually reproduces.

assets_supplied.name: palewell_site_grabs/ (5 PNGs)
assets_supplied.kind: Screengrabs of the current website showing the template photography in place, saved as reference for how much room the header gives an image.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Roughly the proportions we have to work with. Ignore the pictures, we are replacing all of them."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: These are screen scale captures, so anything anyone is tempted to reuse out of them cannot be brought up to hero size: the crop tool will interpolate toward a requested size up to a hard two times cap and report it only inside its own returned tradeoff record, with no warning language anywhere in the response.

assets_supplied.name: palewell_employer_onepager.pdf
assets_supplied.kind: The single page leave behind their print vendor produced last autumn, supplied as the press PDF the vendor sent back: a photograph panel across the top, a name and plan tier block, a body paragraph and a contact footer.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "What the printer made us. We want the same page, fourteen times, with each partner's details on it."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: What the printed page shows as four separate visual blocks is not what the conversion exposes as editable frames, and the granularity is not under anyone's control: the flow may collapse into a single story, and the photograph panel may or may not survive as a linkable frame depending on how the vendor placed it. Separately, the structure readout of that story is lossy in a way that keeps line breaks while dropping a run, so every character offset past the omission is short and the validator still reports the mapping as valid.

assets_supplied.name: palewell_employers.csv (14 rows)
assets_supplied.kind: The partner roster: employer name, plan tier, benefits contact, contact email, contact phone, and a column of logo filenames.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Fourteen partners, one row each, exactly as our operations lead keeps it."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: The logo column is headed as an ordinary text column rather than in the form the merge actually binds images from, so a run built straight off this file places no logo at all on any record while reporting complete success, and three of the fourteen employer names carry a long legal suffix that a fixed measure frame will not spill but will simply stop rendering at trim.

assets_supplied.name: palewell_brand_notes.md
assets_supplied.kind: Two pages of internal notes: the palette described in words (a deep slate, a warm chalk, a single muted signal colour), the tone of voice, and what the founders mean by calm.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "How we talk about ourselves. There is no brand book, this is it."

assets_supplied.name: palewell_copy.txt
assets_supplied.kind: Approved headline and subhead options for the header and the three ad canvases, plus the one-pager body paragraph as cleared by their compliance reviewer.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The compliance reviewed copy. The body paragraph on the leave behind cannot be reworded."

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the licensed frames actually look like once they are beside each other at full resolution and graded. The founders' shortlist exists only as small content delivery thumbnails, and a thumbnail is a proxy that flattens colour: two of the frames carry a strong practical light cast that the thumbnail simply does not carry, and one that reads as the warmest candidate in the grab turns out to be the most neutral file on disk. None of this is visible until the frames are downloaded at full size and laid against the set that has already been brought to the house neutral.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering does not dodge it, because there is no route to the true file except licensing and downloading it, and licensing is the commitment. Nothing states it: the brief says the founders keep picking six pictures that do not sit together, which is the symptom they are hiring someone to solve, not a disclosure that the thumbnails misreport. It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is either a confined correction that a whole frame move cannot reach or a decision to drop a licensed frame and go back to search with a different direction, which is a different route rather than the same one again.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Re-judge every licensed frame against the graded set rather than against its own thumbnail, confine corrections on the frames whose cast is regional rather than global, and where a frame cannot be brought to the set, return to search and license a replacement, updating the manifest for both.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A site and ad set that still reads as bought, which is the exact failure the client described and the exact thing they are paying to stop, delivered with the licensing paperwork proving they paid for it.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: Whether the clinical lead's cutout actually holds. Her pale scrub top runs at almost the luminance of the corridor wall across her right shoulder and upper arm, so subject detection has nothing to work with there and gives back a cutout that is clean, complete and entirely convincing against white and against a transparency preview, having quietly bitten into the shoulder line. The bite is only visible on the deep house ground at the size the header actually reproduces, which is the one place the asset is going to live.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: No ordering avoids it: the knockout has to happen before it can be placed, and there is no parameter that controls where detection finds contrast. Doing it right the first time presumes knowing in advance which of her edges has no contrast against the wall, which is a property of this photograph and not readable from it. Nothing states it: the brief says only that the header sits on the deep slate and she must sit on it cleanly, which is the client's art direction. It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is a different chain entirely, selecting the wall as a material by its own visual properties, inverting that selection and filling to the house ground so the edge is decided by the ground rather than by subject detection.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Abandon the one call knockout for this frame, rebuild the cutout through a material named selection of the corridor wall, inverted, then re-derive both the transparent variant and the house ground plate from the new route and re-judge the shoulder and the hairline on the deep ground at header size.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: A header whose only real human, the clinical lead the whole trust claim rests on, has a shoulder eaten out of her, shipped on the front page of a health brand and invisible in every check that was run against white.

emergent_checkpoints.what_can_only_be_learned_by_running: What the employer press PDF actually becomes. The printed page shows four clearly separate visual blocks, and the conversion's frame granularity is not under anyone's control: the name, plan tier, body and contact may arrive as one continuous story rather than four mappable frames, and the photograph panel may or may not survive as a linkable frame depending on how the vendor placed it. On top of that, the structure readout of the story is lossy in a way that preserves line breaks while dropping a run, so the string looks well formed while every offset past the omission is short, and the mapping built from it validates cleanly and prepares cleanly.
emergent_checkpoints.why_unavoidable: Ordering cannot dodge it because the conversion is the first thing that can be done and its result is the thing in question. Doing it right the first time presumes knowing which of several possible structures this particular vendor's PDF collapses into, which no response reports and no inspection of the printed page reveals. Nothing states it: the client says only that the printer made them a one page leave behind. It is not a propagation re-run, because the response is a different mapping strategy altogether, offsets computed against the reconstructed story rather than the readout, and the per partner logo routed to whichever frame actually exists rather than to the one the printed page implies.
emergent_checkpoints.likely_rework: Reconstruct the true story text from the exported document's own runs, recompute every offset against that string, rebuild the mapping around the frames that genuinely exist, re-prepare the template, and confirm every placeholder by re-exporting the structure rather than by reading the success message.
emergent_checkpoints.failure_if_undetected: Fourteen pages that print, look right in a thumbnail, and are missing two of the five personalised fields on every single one, handed to a print shop and then to fourteen employer partners.

decision_gates: Which stock candidates could plausibly be brought to one house neutral together, judged on their existing light rather than on which thumbnail is prettiest.
Which frame in the set defines the house neutral, since every other frame is then corrected toward it and that choice cannot be revisited cheaply.
Whether a licensed frame that will not come to the set is worth saving with confined corrections or should be replaced, and how to say so.
Knockout route for the clinical lead: the one call route, or a material named selection of the wall inverted and filled, chosen on evidence from her actual edges rather than by reflex.
Whether the header lockup ships as a transparent asset or as a house ground plate, judged on the ground it lands on rather than on which file looks better in isolation.
The type pairing, which the recommender refuses to make, judged against a subscription band and a benefits lead reader, plus the real numeric weight per family.
How much air the four canvases carry. At this band restraint is the design, and a dense benefit stacked header is a correct looking wrong answer.
Which fields the converted template can actually carry, given that the printed page is not evidence about the document's structure.

Nothing shipped is a generative tech result, and every licensed frame is accounted for in the manifest by asset id, contributor and licence state.
The header and the three ad canvases live in ONE working file, each keeping its own canvas size, and the self contained source it was built from is delivered alongside it.

The note records what was licensed and why, what was applied per frame and why that frame differed from its neighbours, every resize any tool reported, and anything the founders should know before they edit the working file themselves.
Every supplied asset is listed in the delivery manifest as used, reference-only, superseded, or rejected with a concrete reason; no input disappears silently.
Final files open successfully, use unambiguous names, match the stated dimensions and formats, and include editable sources only where the scoped deliverable requires them.

why_not_vlm: Paste the brief and the assets into a frontier image model and it returns pleasant pictures of clinicians. IDENTITY: the clinical lead is a real person the client has cleared, on the front page of a health brand, and a regenerated face is a different person the client cannot lawfully or honestly put there; the fourteen employer partners are real counterparties whose names, plan tiers and logos must be exactly theirs. LICENSING: the deliverable explicitly includes provenance, an asset id and licence state per frame and generative tech excluded by policy, and a generated image has no provenance to give, which in a compliance sensitive category is the whole point. SPEC: fourteen pages, one partner per page, in roster order, on the printer's existing page, with nothing cut off at trim, is a document specification rather than a picture. EDITABILITY: the header and ad set are defined by being editable monthly by an eleven person team that cannot re-commission. And the middle of this engagement is verification against material reality: did this licensed frame actually look like its thumbnail, did this knockout eat her shoulder, does this converted template contain the frames the printed page implies.
